description: This file handles the display and logic for the related list view of a module in the vtiger CRM system, specifically managing call-related contacts or activities. It initializes necessary modules, retrieves entity info, and renders a Smarty template for related lists.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty class used for rendering templates within vtiger CRM.

classes.name: currentModule
classes.description: Represents the current module context in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information based on record ID and module.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to Smarty template for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the specified template using Smarty.
